body:
Opened during R81 PR #251 backfill audit/fix cycle (Decision 5B per overnight wrap 2026-06-15). Search results in the community indexer can return any post `kind` — `voice_note_transcript`, `classroom_lesson`, `event`, plus whatever the indexer adds next. Every renderable kind needs a destination detail screen, AND the backend must filter on the server side so a client can never receive a result kind it can't open.

### Why this matters

If `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_SEARCH` flips ON while any kind lacks a detail screen, the coach taps a real result and either lands on a wrong-object view or a silent React Navigation no-op. PR #251's audit (`audits/PR251_AUDIT_2026-06-14.md` F1) caught this at the voice-note kind. The fix in PR #251 builds `CommunityVoiceNoteDetail` and adds server-side filtering — this issue tracks the remaining doors.

### Required before `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_COMMUNITY_SEARCH` flips ON

#### Mobile detail screens

- [ ] **`CommunityClassroom` detail screen** — currently gated behind `communityClassroom` flag, no detail route registered. Needs: screen component, route registration inside `communityClassroom` flag ternary, deep-link handler from search result, flag-off static pin test.
- [ ] **`CommunityEvent` detail screen** — currently gated behind `communityEvents` flag, no detail route registered. Same shape as above.

#### Backend search contract

- [ ] **Server-side filter on caller's enabled flags** — `community.controller.ts` search handler must intersect the result set against the caller's feature-flag evaluation (γ pattern: `GET /me/feature-flags`, server-evaluated, never trust client). Add a regression test: caller with `communityClassroom: false` receives zero `classroom_lesson` results even if matches exist.
- [ ] **Define behavior for unknown result kinds** — backend must return empty filter (not 404, not 500) when the indexer adds a kind that has no client-visible mapping. Add a forward-compat test that injects a synthetic `kind: 'cohort_post'` result and asserts the response excludes it cleanly.

#### Telemetry & verification

- [ ] **Pre-flag-flip telemetry sweep** — confirm `community.search_submitted`, `community.search_result_tapped` are firing on every kind, including the new detail screens. Required by R78 (telemetry pinned in same PR as the surface).
- [ ] **End-to-end flag-on smoke test** — with `communitySearch`, `communityClassroom`, `communityEvents`, and `communityVoiceNotes` all ON in a staging build, search for a term that matches each kind, tap each result, assert the right screen renders.

### Already resolved in PR #251 fix cycle

- [x] `CommunityVoiceNoteDetail` screen built (per Decision 4B)
- [x] Flag-off static pin tests added for `communitySearch` and `coachCommunityWearablePrompts` navigators

### References

- `audits/PR251_AUDIT_2026-06-14.md` F1 — original finding
- `audits/PR399_AUDIT_2026-06-14.md` — backend companion (search controller, telemetry registry)
- `handoffs/OVERNIGHT_WRAP_2026-06-15_audit-phase-complete.md` — decision matrix, γ pattern

### Owner

Bradley Gleave (until reassigned)



---

### Updated 2026-06-15 — R81 rebuild of PR #251

The original PR #251 merge was reverted (it carried D5 as a build-time env read, not the agreed D5=B+γ server-evaluated gate). The work was rebuilt on `fix/pr251-r81-rebuild-v2` and re-opened as a fresh PR, tracked under R82 (#258). The rebuild closes findings F1–F8 + N1–N2:

- **F1** — `CommunityVoiceNoteDetail` built; a `voice_note_transcript` hit routes with the **voiceNoteId** (not a postId) + the matched transcript excerpt (D4=B).
- **F2** — runtime gating is now the server-evaluated `useFeatureFlags()` map from `GET /me/feature-flags` (D5=B+γ, fail-safe OFF), not an env read. Backend contract: PR #414.
- **F8** — a `classroom_lesson` / `event` hit only navigates when the matching server flag is ON; otherwise a calm in-surface notice replaces the dead-end.
- **N1/N2** — `useWearablePrompts` no longer fetches before every precondition holds; failed dismiss/act-on render an inline retry instead of being silently absorbed.

The checklist items above (classroom/event detail screens, backend cross-flag filter, telemetry sweep, end-to-end smoke) remain the gate before `communitySearch` flips ON.
title: Track: community surfaces required before flipping `communitySearch` ON
